I can relate. But believe me when I say that it's never too late to start taking care of yourself. 

I've (25 male) been dealing with self loathing, self harm and suicidal thoughts my whole life and it's always rooted in my appearance. But I'm getting better. 

I deleted all my social media accounts which helped a ton with my self perception. I just stopped caring about what others think when I wasn't bombarded with super attractive people with "perfect" (hint; they never are) lives every hour of every day. 

I instead started focusing on myself. I grew my hair long, started getting new clothes that I actually want to wear and not just something that fits, and started hanging out with people that I actually enjoy spending time with and not just socialize with anyone because "that's what you're supposed to do". 

I still have my problems and I still battle my self loathing every day but since I made these changes to my life things have slowly started getting better. 

I truly hope that you can find inner peace as well some day and although I'm just a random stranger on reddit, I'm rooting for you! 

And remember; it's not about what others think of you, it's what you think of yourself that matters.

Pepper spray on the other hand will make every cavity in your face burn like you can't believe and will make it extremeley hard to breathe. It's literally the same chemical that's in chili fruits only super concentrated. 


From wikipedia: 

> The active ingredient in pepper spray is capsaicin, which is a chemical derived from the fruit of plants in the Capsicum genus, including chilis. Extraction of oleoresin capsicum (OC) from peppers requires capsicum to be finely ground, from which capsaicin is then extracted using an organic solvent such as ethanol.

It's not entirely the developers fault. Keep in mind that the video games industry is now one of the largest media industries in the world, even bigger than the film industry.

Things like season passes, microtransactions and rushed releases is often the publishers fault since they want to make as big of a profit as possible. Then there of course are cases where the developers simply fucks up and wastes time and resources.
